sentences.text: Batman -LRB- often promoted as Batman : The Movie -RRB- is a 1966 American superhero film based on the Batman television series , and the first full-length theatrical adaptation of the DC Comics character Batman .	superhero film	superhero film	DC Comics	DC Comics	Batman	Batman

Released by 20th Century Fox , the film starred Adam West as Batman and Burt Ward as Robin .	Adam West	Adam West	Burt Ward	Burt Ward	20th Century Fox	20th Century Fox	Batman	Batman	Robin	Robin (comics)
The film hit theaters two months after the last episode of the first season of the television series .	last episode of the first season	List of Batman television episodes#Season 1: 1966

The film includes most members of the original TV cast , with the exception of Lee Meriwether as Catwoman , the character previously played by Julie Newmar in two episodes of the series ' first season .	Lee Meriwether	Lee Meriwether	Julie Newmar	Julie Newmar
